title: Lapat PDF
description: A Simple, offline desktop PDF editor for precise image placement and text annotation. Built with Python & PySide6.
bullets: Built a fast, local-only desktop PDF editor with zero network dependency to ensure complete data privacy and instant execution.
Implemented multi-page viewing, precise image/text positioning, custom scaling/rotation/opacity, and a dynamic contextual properties panel.

title: PassIt - URL Shortener
description: A URL shortener with VirusTotal-powered safety checking, built as a personal learning project — Angular on the frontend, Supabase (with an Edge Function) on the backend, and the VirusTotal API doing the actual scanning.
bullets: Built a full-stack platform that verifies every submitted link's safety before granting access, with rate limiting, and RLS-enforced data access.
Built secure account settings and a consistent, accessible design system used across every page.

title: Enhanced Tabu Search for Optimized Rescue Operations
description: A research-driven rescue route optimization system that uses an enhanced Tabu Search algorithm to find efficient evacuation routes while handling large and complex problem spaces.
bullets: Led a 3-member team through research documentation and algorithm development, culminating in a successful thesis defense.
Increased solution diversity by 7–10x by implementing controlled pattern adjustments, cutting the algorithm's tendency to get stuck in suboptimal solutions.
Accelerated algorithm runtime by 8.7x and improved solution quality by 58% by optimizing evaluation to target only the highest-cost route segments.
Resolved scalability issues with an adaptive memory mechanism that adjusts automatically to problem size.

title: CGrassPLUS
description: A custom programming language project focused on designing and implementing a simple compiler with a structured multi-layer architecture.
bullets: Led a 5-member team building and documenting a custom programming language, defending the final architecture to a technical panel.
Developed a three-layer compiler optimized for low time complexity, delivering an efficient, maintainable codebase.

title: Web-based Faculty Load and Class Scheduling System
description: A web-based scheduling system designed to centralize faculty loads, course assignments, room allocations, and scheduling data in a single system.
bullets: Architected a centralized database ensuring 100% data integrity across courses, faculty preferences, and room allocations.
Led code reviews and repository management for clean, consistent integration of development requests, contributing to a successful project defense.
